nba.period_margin_pmf.reviewed_by: Agent certification review (Claude), 2026-11-20; not human verified.

catalog_clauses.clause: From all games in 5 seasons compute standardized period margin and total (actual minus rating-based expectation, built without market lines)
fit a discrete mixture (Skellam-like with pace-dependent variance and a small-excess-kurtosis component) per period type (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, 1H, 2H-with-OT)
catalog_clauses.note: two-component discretized normal mixture; (w, k) per season and period in nba_dist_ext13.PARAMS; margin fits select w = 0 at grid resolution (no excess-kurtosis component supported), 2H total selects w 0.1-0.2

catalog_clauses.clause: via maximum likelihood with a team-pair variance covariate
catalog_clauses.note: exact grid maximum likelihood (deterministic grid, documented); pair = mean of both teams' shrunk standardized-residual variance

catalog_clauses.clause: report pmf at integer margins within +/-25
catalog_clauses.note: pmf() reconstructs the full integer pmf; tie (0) and >= 8 (7.5 strike) masses are the row columns

catalog_clauses.clause: and the tie probability by expected pace tercile

nba.period_margin_pmf.timing_rule: expectations from earlier games only; fits on seasons S-5..S-1 only; pair covariate from strictly earlier games; replay truncation, future-perturbation and own-game gates
nba.period_margin_pmf.required_history: 5 seasons of linescores: vault schedules 2020-2027 linescores; outputs 2025-2027 (first season with five earlier linescore seasons)
